paragraphs.text:
You turn your attention to Officer Powell and plead with him to 
release you. Initially, he pays you no mind. Eventually, however, 
you mention that you’ll leave town if he lets you go, and that 
seems to seal the deal.

“Having you out of the way makes my life a bit easier. Get the hell 
out of here before I change my mind. If I see you again, you’re getting 
a bullet.” You do not hesitate to leave the cell as he unlocks it.
